title: Attention Misses Visual Risk: Risk-Adaptive Steering for Multimodal Safety Alignment

summary.claim: MLLMs are vulnerable to harmful intent hidden in images partly because they pay too little attention to safety-critical image regions. MoRAS strengthens that attention, estimates risk, and adaptively steers toward refusal.
summary.condition: Inference-time defense with no extra generation and only a small calibration set; several MLLMs and benchmarks.
summary.gap: (Inferred) How representative the calibration set must be, and generalization to new kinds of multimodal jailbreaks, are open.
